title: The All-Reduce Atlas
description: Where decentralized training nodes sit on Earth and what it costs to sync them. Toggle INTELLECT-1's three measured configurations and watch the ring all-reduce span the globe: 103s inside the USA, 382s across the Atlantic, 469s once Asia joins.
controls: tap a configuration to redraw the ring (or use ← / →)
tap / focus a node to read its region
watch median all-reduce climb 103s → 382s → 469s as the ring spans more continents
